900.3.10(155).explanation: Exception RD 155 keeps each lot's 2013 frontage and area as its minimums, requires buildings to sit at least 24.0 m from the original centreline of Kingston Rd. where the lot abuts Kingston Rd., sets side yard setbacks of 0.9 m (3.6 m where the side lot line abuts a street), and applies exception 1462. Several named addresses on Midland Ave., Chine Dr., Kingston Rd., Kelsonia Ave., Scarboro Cres. and Cliffcrest Dr. remain governed by provisions of the former City of Scarborough by-law 9364, which we do not evaluate.

900.3.10(633).explanation: Exception RD 633 keeps each lot's 2013 frontage and area as its minimums, requires a 3.0 m setback from street lot lines, side yards of 1.2 m on one side and 0.6 m on the other, a maximum height of 14.5 m and 3 storeys, a 5.7 m setback for a street-facing garage entrance, and compliance with exception 1462. No prevailing by-laws apply.
